entries.rationale: The stem explicitly names the agreed Abfindung; the answer denotes entitlement to that payment rather than leave, information or repayment. Legal correctness beyond this illustrative lexical distinction is not certified.

Explicit agreed severance identifies the compound entitlement; no damage, remuneration or leave fact is supplied. The item distinguishes a payment from a claim to it, not a general legal entitlement rule.
Separate completion cue supports working through the backlog; printing, archiving and distributing do not themselves complete the pending requests. Nominalized infinitive and das agree.
Formal acceptance and recording defects support the acceptance record; maintenance schedule, estimate and construction schedule name different document functions.
Gymnasiale Oberstufe and allgemeine Hochschulreife supply the school-qualification context absent from the original stem. Internship, degree and interview do not name that qualification.
The final school class and explicit Schulabschluss constrain the item to Abitur; the remaining options are not this school qualification.

Written objection and requested future compliance, with the tenancy continuing, distinguish a warning from termination, billing and invitation. This is illustrative vocabulary, not a legal procedure certification.
Explicit drawing and bildliche Darstellung identify the image itself, rather than its caption, prose or heading; added feminine article makes the completed definition idiomatic.
Positive exciting discovery context supports Abenteuer; removing Experiment avoids the close experimental-activity alternative. The remaining nouns do not normally denote this experience.
Excitement about a new camping experience supports Abenteuer; Experiment is replaced. A puzzle, misfortune or accidental mistake does not normally describe the stated positive exploration.

All four options now fit the zu-infinitive slot structurally; abzumildern expresses reducing heat, whereas increasing, causing or spreading it opposes the stated purpose. Original accepted option ID retained.
The recommendation explicitly advises against the investment and the second clause identifies what that recommendation does, favoring abraten over reporting, convincing or congratulating.
A date already fixed but unavailable to outsiders rules out not festgelegt; absehbar supplies predictability from their information, while forgotten/excluded have no stated basis.
Keinerlei Zweifel supplies complete certainty, supporting absolut rather than partial, approximate or low certainty.
An available roadworthy car and explicit choice against driving establish substitution, not lack of a car or a spatial relation; statt governs the existing genitive phrase.

Bilingual instruction explicitly requests temporal ordering, excluding a conditional interpretation; bevor correctly introduces the later action.
Instruction requests intended purpose, not chronology or condition; damit expresses the desired understanding.
Independent same action is explicitly requested, so ebenfalls expresses addition without introducing a cause, contrast or replacement.
Instruction requests the means of saving energy; indem identifies the method rather than condition, time or concession.
Instruction specifies method rather than temporal sequence; indem relates pronunciation improvement to the practice method.
Requested contrast between advantage and disadvantage supports jedoch; causal and additive alternatives do not express that requested relation.
Requested contradiction of the expected effect of delay supports obwohl, not merely chronological nachdem or cause/purpose.
Instruction explicitly requests action contrary to a warning, selecting obwohl rather than a time sequence or purpose.
Requested consequence of stronger wind selects so dass rather than simultaneous während, means or condition. The separated spelling is preserved as supplied.
Instruction asks for the entire duration rather than onset, distinguishing solange from sobald; concession and purpose do not describe duration.
Shaking hands explicitly from nervousness supplies the tension cue; angespannt is the ordinary emotional-state reading rather than relaxed/calm/cheerful.

The pupil explicitly accepts the apology before restating the action. Akzeptiert names that acceptance; analysing does not express the already established action.
Only after the course does the question period begin; anschließend states the required sequence and vorher contradicts it.
Bilingual instruction specifically asks for physical presence, so anwesend expresses the supplied fact. Illness is a different property and is not an alternative answer to that stated task.
Unambiguous highlighting establishes expressly stated registration; incidental, secret and presumed readings conflict with that cue.
An ongoing discussion establishes that the meeting has started already; not yet/never/later readings contradict that supplied state. Bereits correctly modifies the past-perfect clause.
The instruction explicitly asks for only/limited quantity, distinguishing bloß from at least, extra and even; the small-amount context agrees with that semantic task.
The current successful attempt is contrasted with earlier failures, and the instruction explicitly asks for this particular occasion rather than a period up to now or a different time.
The plate starts on the ground and must have space underneath; anheben supplies raising it, whereas holding, setting down or lateral moving do not express that upward action.
Paying the purchase price and becoming owner supplies buying rather than borrowing, returning or giving away; ankaufen fits the museum collection context.
The explicit unverified-supposition instruction distinguishes assumed truth from reporting, proof or denial; angenommen supplies that mental attitude.
The instruction explicitly asks for an unverified belief, excluding announcement, demand and prevention; angenommen fits the past-perfect form.
The stated burden lifting supplies emotional relief, so befreiend fits rather than threatening, restricting or confusing. Adjective form fits als.
Inheritance of eye colour supplies the ordinary living-organism/genetic reading for biologischer. Legal and economic inheritance of property is no longer the topic; no historical account is supplied.

Completed tests and the instruction requesting already available rather than predicted results select bisherigen over future, planned or expected results; adjective ending agrees with plural accusative.

Additional AI-assisted recheck of the exact proposal, not independent human approval. The new bilingual instruction explicitly requests side-to-side traversal, not a return journey. Quer names that orientation; parallel lacks an axis, entlang does not fit über die Wiese, and zurück is now expressly outside the requested distinction. The revised hint mentions the opposite edge without giving the answer. German completion and original accepted option 1 remain coherent.

Additional AI-assisted recheck of the exact proposal, not independent human approval. Front-first entry and inability to turn establish rear-first exit. The instruction asks which end leads: rückwärts answers this, vorwärts reverses it, seitwärts is lateral, and geradeaus concerns path shape and is explicitly outside task scope. Existing rear-first bilingual hint and reverse-direction explanation agree; modal infinitive herausfahren and the original key are retained.

Additional AI-assisted recheck of the exact proposal, not independent human approval. Heck zuerst establishes rear-first movement, and the revised instruction distinguishes front/rear orientation from straightness. Rückwärts is supported; vorwärts contradicts it, seitlich names a different orientation and geradeaus cannot answer which end leads. The unchanged rear-first hints, explanation and grammatical subordinate-clause completion remain aligned.

Additional AI-assisted recheck of the exact proposal, not independent human approval. The bilingual instruction now requires the successful final outcome. Schließlich supplies that culmination; zunächst is initial, nie denies success and früher merely locates a previous time. The original effort/outcome hint and eventual-result explanation remain accurate; uns ... auf einen Termin geeinigt retains correct reflexive construction and accepted option 0.

Additional AI-assisted recheck of the exact proposal, not independent human approval. The revised stem explicitly permits earlier arrival and rules out anything after 7:50, establishing a latest boundary independently of eight-o’clock departure. Spätestens preserves it, frühestens sets the opposite boundary, ungefähr allows later times and vielleicht makes the obligation uncertain. Bilingual deadline instruction/hint/explanation fit; sei ... dort is grammatical and the original accepted option 2 is retained.

Additional AI-assisted recheck of the exact proposal, not independent human approval. A fully closed road segment with the remaining length open makes only partial usability explicit. Teilweise fits; vollständig and durchgehend conflict with the closed segment, while überhaupt nicht conflicts with the open remainder and is also awkward after nur. The bilingual part-versus-whole hint and explanation still match; stored completion exactly inserts option 0.

Additional AI-assisted recheck of the exact proposal, not independent human approval. The new German hint removes the exact answer überhaupt and parallels the English distinction between any acquaintance and its extent. The ordinary question-final überhaupt asks whether the person is known at all; üblicherweise implies a recurring pattern, teilweise an unusual partial-acquaintance reading, and schließlich is not the natural final-position marker. Original prompt, option 1, at-all explanation and completed question remain unchanged. This is a scoped hint repair, not proof of every possible pragmatic reading.

Additional AI-assisted recheck of the exact proposal, not independent human approval. The scored bilingual instruction now explicitly asks for a fundamental yes/no existence-of-operation question. Überhaupt provides this force; teilweise asks extent, üblicherweise asks habitual status and spätestens lacks the necessary deadline complement. The revised hint contains no offered answer. Both existing at-all explanations and the completion agree, while option 2 and all original identities remain fixed.

Additional AI-assisted recheck of the exact proposal, not independent human approval. The revised instruction requests the equipment category, excluding the competing place-membership reading. Arbeitsmitteln names the needed laptops collectively; Arbeitsplätzen names sites, Arbeitsverträgen agreements and Arbeitszeiten periods. Zu den Arbeitsmitteln has the proper dative plural ending. Existing bilingual equipment hints/explanations and accepted option 2 remain coherent.

Additional AI-assisted recheck of the exact proposal, not independent human approval. Replacing the overlapping Arbeitsstellen with Arbeitszeiten removes the physical-workplace synonym without making a false dictionary claim. Factory buildings are Arbeitsstätten; they are not times, contracts or ordinary tools/equipment in this vocabulary classification. All option IDs and accepted option 1 are unchanged. Both-language premises hints/explanations and the plural completion agree.

Additional AI-assisted recheck of the exact proposal, not independent human approval. The added relative clause explicitly identifies the speakers as seeking a new job. Arbeitssuchende directly names that role; Kunden, Vorgesetzte and Lieferanten could describe people with other overlapping roles but do not name the employment-seeking status the stem defines. Bare plural -e and plural relative die ... suchen agree. Existing seeker-not-provider bilingual hints, explanations, option 2 and completion match.

Additional AI-assisted recheck of the exact proposal, not independent human approval. The new bilingual instruction explicitly requests the specific allocation of different task components between teams. Arbeitsteilung names that relationship, while Arbeitsweise is a broader method and is expressly excluded; Arbeitswelt and Arbeitsstelle denote neither task allocation. The packing/transport example, task-division hints and explanations remain natural, with accepted option 2 intact.

Additional AI-assisted recheck of the exact proposal, not independent human approval. The new instruction requests the collective whole of professions, employment forms and conditions. Arbeitswelt fits that level; Arbeitsstätte and Arbeitsstelle are individual sites/positions, while Arbeitsteilung denotes task distribution rather than the whole sphere. This narrows the task without falsely saying digitization cannot change task division. The bilingual broad-scope hint/explanation, feminine completion and accepted option 2 remain aligned.

Additional AI-assisted recheck of the exact proposal, not independent human approval. The bilingual instruction now expressly asks for displaying works to visitors, not evaluating them. Ausstellen uniquely names that display action among ausstellen/auswerten/ausüben/ausrichten; Werke ausrichten is not organizing an exhibition. Existing visitor hints and exhibition explanations agree, and the modal infinitive completion and accepted option 0 remain correct.

Additional AI-assisted recheck of the exact proposal, not independent human approval. The German definition now says einander Informationen mitzuteilen, matching mutual sharing rather than the misleading Informationen wechseln. Erfahrungen miteinander austauschen is natural; ausstellen, ausüben and ausschließen do not denote the requested reciprocal sharing. Both-language sharing/replacement hints remain accurate and option 1 reconstructs the unchanged grammatical completion.

Additional AI-assisted recheck of the exact proposal, not independent human approval. The new German two-sense explanation accurately separates mutual information sharing from replacing an object. Gegen ein neues ausgetauscht is the correct replacement frame; ausgestellt, ausgerichtet and ausgewertet do not mean replacement and do not fit gegen ein neues with that meaning. English explanation, replacement hint and passive completion agree; option 2 is unchanged.

Additional AI-assisted recheck of the exact proposal, not independent human approval. The scored instruction now requires analysis and interpretation, not display or selection, resolving the original broad subsequent-action reading. Ausgewertet fits that task; ausgestellt and ausgesucht are expressly outside its scope, while ausgerichtet does not mean drawing conclusions. Existing bilingual data-analysis hints/explanations and both past participles in the completion remain coherent; option 1 is retained.

Additional AI-assisted recheck of the exact proposal, not independent human approval. The revised English hint merely says that the repair requires time, matching German bestimmte Dauer and avoiding the unsupported longer-than-expected claim. Beanspruchen alone expresses duration required; a repair does not apply for days, heed them or process them. Both time-sense explanations and future infinitive completion are correct, with accepted option 2 preserved.

Additional AI-assisted recheck of the exact proposal, not independent human approval. The German feedback now paraphrases the verb as einen offiziellen Antrag auf etwas stellen rather than defining it with itself; English gives the same formal-request sense. For a traveler needing a new visa, beantragen fits, bearbeiten implies a processor role, beachten is observance and beanspruchen claims entitlement rather than submitting a request. Existing bilingual applicant hints and modal completion match; option 2 stays fixed.

Additional AI-assisted recheck of the exact proposal, not independent human approval. The revised bilingual formal-request explanation fits the explicit applicant role and avoids the German circular definition. Beantragt describes requesting the subsidy; bewilligt and ausgezahlt belong to the granting/paying role, and begründet would normally take Antrag or Bedarf rather than substitute for the requesting action here. The accusative subsidy and perfect participle completion agree, with option 0 unchanged.

Additional AI-assisted recheck of the exact proposal, not independent human approval. The revised German hint no longer supplies the lexical answer bearbeitet, and both hints allow handling a case or changing content. A caseworker sequentially handles received applications: bearbeiten is the specific processing action, beantragen is making a request, beachten is only taking account and beanspruchen is claiming. Existing method/content explanation and modal completion remain coherent, with option 1 retained.

Additional AI-assisted recheck of the exact proposal, not independent human approval. The revised German hint removes the exact offered answer bearbeitet. Correcting brightness and colors specifies actual image editing, not requesting, claiming or merely attending to pictures. Both new hint languages and the existing content-editing explanations align; hat ... bearbeitet retains the proper inseparable-prefix participle without ge- and accepted option 2.

Additional AI-assisted recheck of the exact proposal, not independent human approval. The revised first sentence explicitly forbids laboratory entry without glasses. Erforderlich now names the necessary condition; verboten reverses it, optional denies necessity and unpassend is not the stated requirement. The unchanged bilingual prerequisite hints/explanations and singular Schutzbrille completion agree. Accepted option 2 is preserved.

Additional AI-assisted recheck of the exact proposal, not independent human approval. The new bilingual scored instruction requires a possible but uncertain consequence. Eventuell expresses that modality; garantiert and immer assert certainty while niemals denies occurrence. The conditional clause remains grammatical and the uncertainty hints/explanations match the requested consequence rather than merely an uncertain trigger. Accepted option 2 is preserved.

Additional AI-assisted recheck of the exact proposal, not independent human approval. The instruction now fixes the dimension as directly stated versus implied wording. Explizit matches ausdruecklich in the original stem, indirekt reverses directness, and beiläufig/versehentlich describe prominence or intention, expressly outside the requested dimension. Both-language direct-statement hints/explanations and hat ... formuliert remain coherent. The accepted option 2 remains unchanged.

Additional AI-assisted recheck of the exact proposal, not independent human approval. The revised options contrast rule-respecting fair play with unfair, regelwidrig and unzulässig. They no longer imply that aggressive intensity is incompatible with fair sport. Both explicit compliance and respect in the prompt support fair, with unchanged bilingual rules/fairness feedback, completed sentence and accepted option 2.

Additional AI-assisted recheck of the exact proposal, not independent human approval. The corrected choice group contrasts fehlerhaft with fehlerfrei, korrekt and richtig, all direct correctness alternatives. Repeated wrong readings support the error descriptor rather than any of those correctness terms; the instruction explicitly asks about readings, avoiding claims that inaccurate readings are necessarily imprecise or physically broken. Both-language error hints/explanations and the completion fit, with accepted option 0 unchanged.

Additional AI-assisted recheck of the exact proposal, not independent human approval. The revised stem explicitly makes the guide leader and says all others follow her. Voraus expresses her front position; hinterher reverses that position, entgegen implies meeting the group rather than leading it and vorbei requires a different an-phrase construction. Existing bilingual leading/following hints and explanation now follow from the scored stem. The dative der Gruppe, completion and accepted option 2 stay correct.

Additional AI-assisted recheck of the exact proposal, not independent human approval. The revised bilingual instruction asks only for front position relative to the following owner. Voraus names that relation; zurück describes a return direction and herum a path pattern, both now excluded as answers to the requested dimension, while daneben is beside rather than in front. The unchanged running sentence and ahead/following feedback agree; accepted option 0 is retained. Simultaneous return motion is no longer falsely declared impossible.

Additional AI-assisted recheck of the exact proposal, not independent human approval. Both revised explanations explicitly limit the continuation gloss to this context and acknowledge außerdem/furthermore elsewhere. The existing contract/service context and continuation hint support weiterhin over first-ever, never or no-longer provision. The future infinitive anbieten and completed sentence remain intact, with option 1 retained; no universal rejection of the source gloss is made.

Additional AI-assisted recheck of the exact proposal, not independent human approval. The revised bilingual definition allows both continuation here and addition elsewhere. Unchanged existing opening times establish weiterhin, excluding erstmals, nie and statt-dessen replacement in the stated schedule context. Hints and the completion about opening at eight remain coherent, and accepted option 3 is unchanged; no real shop schedule is asserted.

Additional AI-assisted recheck of the exact proposal, not independent human approval. The new hints state only that interest is not charged and expressly leave separate fees unspecified, accurately matching null Prozent rather than promising principal-only total cost. Zinslos fits the stipulated absence of interest; hochverzinst contradicts zero, variabel verzinst is not established and verzinst is not the ordinary absence-of-interest description. Both original interest-free explanations and completion align, with option 1 preserved.

Additional AI-assisted recheck of the exact proposal, not independent human approval. The new bilingual instruction explicitly requests simultaneous dual functions, not earlier or later use. Zugleich states coexistence, zuvor/danach order roles in time and stattdessen substitutes rather than adds. Both original simultaneity hints/explanations and the dual als construction remain natural. This concerns functions/capacities, not a claim that a meeting and desk work must occur at the same instant; accepted option 0 is retained.

Additional AI-assisted recheck of the exact proposal, not independent human approval. The revised bilingual feedback explicitly defines a supporting/opposing reason and assigns the quarrel sense to English argument versus German Streit. This removes the misleading not-necessarily-a-quarrel formulation. Annual savings are an Argument for adoption, not a rumor, promise or commissioned job; the original supporting-reason hint, neuter agreement, completion and accepted option 2 are intact.

Additional AI-assisted recheck of the exact proposal, not independent human approval. The revised feedback consistently distinguishes German justificatory Argument from English quarrel. High costs are the reason for rejecting the proposal, not a gift, result or prohibition. Both-language reason hints, the superlative neuter wichtigstes Argument and accepted option 0 agree; no corrected German-source input is written.

Additional AI-assisted recheck of the exact proposal, not independent human approval. The new verschreibungspflichtigen modifier establishes a prescription-only product rather than merely something sold in a pharmacy. Arzneimittels fits the medicine category; a generic food, furniture item or tool does not express the ordinary prescription-drug meaning in this batch-recall context. Eines verschreibungspflichtigen Arzneimittels has correct genitive endings, and original bilingual treatment hints/medicine explanations, completion and option 2 match. No actual recall or prescription advice is claimed.

Additional AI-assisted recheck of the exact proposal, not independent human approval. The new bilingual instruction requests the noun denoting time spent at a place. Aufenthalts names that stay; Auftrags and Aufbaus denote the excluded assigned task or construction, and Aufpreises denotes money. Während ihres zweimonatigen Aufenthalts retains correct masculine genitive and the museum habit remains compatible with a stay. Bilingual hints/explanations and accepted option 2 are unchanged.

Additional AI-assisted recheck of the exact proposal, not independent human approval. The scored instruction now explicitly asks for item-by-item enumeration rather than evaluation or a condensed summary. Auflistung names this specific format; Empfehlung is advice, Bewertung is judgment and Zusammenfassung names the excluded condensed account. This does not deny that an itemized list may also be part of a broader summary. Both-language every-item hints and listing explanations, feminine accusative completion and option 2 are retained.

limitations: This rechecks the specified proposed task only; it is not a CEFR, rights or legal certification.
No runtime candidate, target approval or publication flag is activated.
A later change to any proposal invalidates its exact-hash-bound recheck.
